mentions.name: Sanctum
mentions.description: A native iOS voice journal app, like Obsidian but for voice notes, with one-click recording, self-organization of notes and ideas, and a focus on data sovereignty and privacy. Transcription uses AssemblyAI, LLM inference runs in a TEE via redpill.ai, backups use end-to-end encryption with Backblaze storage, and the backend uses AWS Lambdas, DynamoDB for billing storage, and Supabase for auth.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I have been joyfully working on a native iOS app called Sanctum.  I really built this for myself and use it multiple times a day (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/sanctum-the-voice-journal/id6796428879)

Sanctum is a voice journal, think Obsidian but for voice notes.  I am really honing in on data sovereignty, privacy, 1 click to record and self organization of notes / ideas.
mentions.author: mikodin
